status: PROPOSED. Things the world gives the player. m_c_n16, m_c_gloved_lady and m_c_boxes are read from the newspaper panel, m_notebook_spine, m_glove_scrap and m_register are drawn by hand, m_backup_ledger comes only from the register line in photo_window.json, m_aviation_card and m_nadia_card are read at the window; the 4B mirror question reads the saved return-look observation. Other carriers require individual verification. Each entry says what grants the flag. Dates come from section 3.1 of the treatment.
